items.title: How to prevent MacBook Pro notch from hiding menu bar icons (from the right)
items.x_text:
❓ How to prevent MacBook Pro notch from hiding menu bar icons (from the right)

✅ Use Bartender app to manage menu bar icons and avoid the notch.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M4IUlUI1BrE
#COSMOS #monterey

discovery.short_answer: Use Bartender app to manage menu bar icons and avoid the notch.
discovery.full_answer: To prevent the MacBook Pro notch from hiding menu bar icons on the right side, the recommended solution is to use the Bartender app. Bartender offers a feature called Bartender Bar that moves icons to a separate space below the menu bar, ensuring they are not obscured by the notch. It also allows users to reduce the spacing between icons, fitting more icons onscreen before reaching the notch area. While Bartender is paid software with a one-time fee of $16 and a free 4-week trial, free alternatives like Dozer and HiddenBar do not prevent icons from being hidden behind the notch when expanded or adjust icon spacing. Note that Bartender has recently changed ownership, and the new owner has not clarified their monetization strategy.
discovery.grok_perspective: The notch's effect on right-side menu bar icons can vary with icon count, resolution, and macOS settings, so outcomes from any adjustment may differ across setups without a single reliable fix.

youtube.title: Too Many Menu Bar Icons? Bartender Fixes This on Mac

items.title: How do I prevent stickiness in a rice cooker?
items.x_text:
❓ How do I prevent stickiness in a rice cooker?

✅ Add a small amount of oil to the rice before cooking.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yuT5-Jvfyzg
#COSMOS #rice

discovery.short_answer: Add a small amount of oil to the rice before cooking.
discovery.full_answer: To prevent rice from sticking in a rice cooker, you can add a small amount of oil, such as corn oil, to the rice and water mixture before cooking. This method helps the rice grains separate more easily and reduces stickiness, making it easier to scoop the rice out once it's cooked. The oil coats the rice grains, which minimizes their tendency to clump together and stick to the cooker’s surface. This simple addition can improve the texture and handling of the cooked rice without altering the basic cooking process.
discovery.grok_perspective: Effectiveness of approaches to reduce rice stickiness often varies with rice type, water ratios, and specific cooker models. Individual outcomes cannot be assured without testing.

items.title: Is the etymology of salary a myth?
items.x_text:
❓ Is the etymology of salary a myth?

✅ The etymology of salary from salt is partly true but somewhat mythic.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oZ7lsNNVcAY
#COSMOS #etymology

discovery.short_answer: The etymology of salary from salt is partly true but somewhat mythic.
discovery.full_answer: The word 'salary' derives from the Latin 'salarium,' which is linked to 'sal,' meaning salt. Roman soldiers were given salt as part of their compensation, highlighting salt's value. However, the idea that soldiers were literally paid in salt is not strongly supported by historical evidence. Ancient texts mention salt taxes and rewards related to salt, but not direct payment of soldiers with salt. The term evolved through Vulgar Latin and French before entering English, referring broadly to compensation. While salt was important and symbolically connected to pay, the common belief that salary means payment in salt is more of a traditional explanation than a precise historical fact.
discovery.grok_perspective: Etymological links between salary and salt merit cautious examination, as they may blend partial linguistic roots with later interpretive layers. Full origins likely involve more nuance than simplified accounts suggest.

youtube.title: Why Roman Soldiers Were Paid in SALT — The True Origin of ‘Salary’!

items.title: How do I professionally decline to disclose my current salary
items.x_text:
❓ How do I professionally decline to disclose my current salary

✅ Politely say you prefer not to discuss your salary history.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d2FO0IzSR7k
#COSMOS #interviewing

discovery.short_answer: Politely say you prefer not to discuss your salary history.
discovery.full_answer: To professionally decline disclosing your current salary, you can simply state that you prefer not to discuss your salary history. If pressed, explain that your past salary agreements are specific to previous employers and may not be relevant to the new position. You might also mention that you consider yourself underpaid, so your current salary does not reflect your market value. While there is a risk that the employer may make an offer contingent on revealing your salary, you must then decide how important the job is to you and whether to disclose or stand firm. This approach helps maintain professionalism and keeps the focus on your qualifications rather than past compensation.
discovery.grok_perspective: Approaches to handling salary inquiries may depend on specific employment laws and workplace norms, which can influence the most suitable response in a given situation.

items.title: Is death by cyanide the same as suffocation?
items.x_text:
❓ Is death by cyanide the same as suffocation?

✅ No, cyanide death differs from suffocation in oxygen use.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M0ZgjsZ2Pc4
#COSMOS #respiration

discovery.short_answer: No, cyanide death differs from suffocation in oxygen use.
discovery.full_answer: Death by cyanide poisoning and suffocation both lead to death but through different mechanisms. Suffocation causes a lack of oxygen intake, leading to low oxygen levels in the blood and tissues, triggering panic and increased breathing efforts. Cyanide poisoning, however, does not reduce oxygen levels in the blood; instead, it prevents cells from using oxygen by inhibiting a key mitochondrial enzyme needed for energy production. This results in oxygen being present but unusable, causing cellular energy failure and eventual death. While both can cause seizures, respiratory arrest, and cardiac arrest, cyanide poisoning leads to a characteristic cherry red skin color due to high oxygen levels in venous blood, unlike the blue skin seen in suffocation from oxygen deprivation.
discovery.grok_perspective: Cyanide poisoning appears to interfere with cellular oxygen utilization in ways that may not align precisely with external oxygen deprivation. Distinctions in physiological effects warrant separate consideration based on available descriptions.

discovery.short_answer: Achilles cried because he admired Hector's honor and saw him as a brother.
discovery.full_answer: Achilles wept over Hector's body because he recognized qualities in Hector that he deeply admired, such as bravery, honor, and having an honorable king and father to serve. Despite killing Hector, Achilles felt a profound connection to him, seeing him as a brother who shared his most important values. This emotional response was influenced by his changed perspective after Priam's visit, which made Achilles reflect on the honor and purpose Hector represented. The tears symbolize Achilles' complex feelings of respect and sorrow for Hector, as well as a sense of loss for the values they both held dear.
discovery.grok_perspective: Interpretations of Achilles' response to Hector's body in ancient accounts may vary, potentially tied to themes of shared mortality or personal loss instead of direct affinity. Such details invite careful reading of the source material.

items.title: Have all of these promised No Man s Sky features been added to the game?
items.x_text:
❓ Have all of these promised No Man s Sky features been added to the game?

✅ No, some promised No Man's Sky features remain unadded.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B9MCcUYdjhI
#COSMOS #Curiosity

discovery.short_answer: No, some promised No Man's Sky features remain unadded.
discovery.full_answer: No Man's Sky has implemented several promised features, such as reachable stars in various star systems, the ability to land and build on asteroids, and unique starship customization with numerous permutations. Players can also recruit wingmen for combat and fly directly to nearby star systems without using the Galaxy Map, though loading screens remain. However, some features are still missing: space stations cannot be destroyed, ships lack cloaking devices, and skyboxes still exist despite stars being in-game objects. There is mention of potential future heat-resistant equipment, but no confirmed update on that. Overall, while progress has been made, not all originally promised features have been fully delivered.
discovery.grok_perspective: Assessing whether every No Man's Sky promise has been fulfilled can depend on how early announcements are interpreted, leaving some aspects potentially unresolved.
